summary: The `no_valid_comparison` closure stands. All 56 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and all five computations reproduced. Figure 5A reports pathway enrichment and gene counts without identifying individual genes or their effects. The corrected proposal records full-paper access and classifies the available author results as `partial` and `not_comparable`. It passed the proposal validator.
openIssues: Figure 5A reports five mice per group. The registered analysis uses six deposited samples per arm, and the published sample membership remains unknown.

The reviewed sources yielded no gene-level author effects for the five-day conjugate-versus-vehicle contrast. The Helmholtz research-data attachment returned zero bytes, so its contents remain unknown.
